findings.title: Directory.Build.props Configuration Issue
findings.description: The Directory.Build.props file had invalid TargetFrameworkIdentifier and PackageReferences that were not compatible with .NET 10.
findings.recommendation: Remove invalid TargetFrameworkIdentifier and use standard .NET 10 configuration

findings.title: Package Version Compatibility
findings.description: Some NuGet packages were not compatible with .NET 10, causing restore failures.
findings.impact: Package restore would fail, preventing build
findings.recommendation: Update all package versions to .NET 10 compatible versions

findings.title: .NET 10 SDK Configuration
findings.description: The .NET 10 SDK was not properly configured in the project files.
findings.impact: Build would fail or use wrong SDK version
findings.recommendation: Configure .NET 10 SDK in global.json and all project files
findings.evidence: No compatible installed .NET SDK for global.json version [10.0.100]

findings.title: Missing GraphValidator.cs
findings.description: The GraphValidator.cs file was referenced in DomainModels.cs but did not exist.
findings.impact: Build would fail with missing file error
findings.recommendation: Create GraphValidator.cs with proper validation logic
findings.evidence: The type or namespace name 'GraphValidator' could not be found

findings.title: Missing ThreatsView.xaml.cs
findings.description: The ThreatsView.xaml.cs code-behind file was referenced but did not exist.
findings.impact: Build would fail with missing file error
findings.evidence: The type or namespace name 'ThreatsView' could not be found

findings.title: Empty Directories
findings.description: Some directories were empty with no files.
findings.recommendation: Populate all directories with necessary files or remove empty directories
findings.evidence: Directory exists but contains no files

findings.title: SOCpit.App.csproj Configuration
findings.description: The SOCpit.App.csproj file was missing required WPF dependencies and configuration.
findings.impact: WPF application would not build or run correctly
findings.recommendation: Add all required WPF dependencies and configuration
findings.evidence: Missing UseWPF, missing WPF package references

findings.title: Missing Using Directives
findings.description: Some files were missing required using directives, causing compilation errors.
findings.recommendation: Add all required using directives to all files
findings.evidence: The name 'X' does not exist in the current context

findings.title: Code Duplication
findings.description: Some code was duplicated across multiple files.
findings.evidence: Same code pattern appears in multiple files

findings.title: WPF Dependencies
findings.impact: WPF features would not work correctly
findings.evidence: The type or namespace name 'System.Windows' could not be found

findings.title: Version Inconsistency
findings.description: Version numbers were inconsistent across different files.
findings.evidence: Different version numbers in different files

findings.title: Missing EvidenceService Hash Calculation
findings.description: The EvidenceService needed a method to calculate file hashes.
findings.impact: Evidence hash could not be calculated
findings.evidence: Hash property was not being calculated
